integrity: Analytic proof plus independent finite exact and asymptotic computational diagnostics; no experimental output is used as proof of an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Even cycles, strictly positive alternating independent Poisson edge-attempt rates; fixed-rate and explicitly stated near-symmetry regimes. No claim for general nonperiodic or non-Poisson environments. Historical priority awaits independent review.
title: Fractional Gumbel corrections and a logarithmic symmetry crossover in alternating-rate dimer coverage
